import sys
import heapq

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a1 = int(next(it)); a2 = int(next(it)); a3 = int(next(it))
    b1 = int(next(it)); b2 = int(next(it)); b3 = int(next(it))

    class Graph:
        def __init__(self, n):
            self.n = n
            self.pos = []
            self.g = [[] for _ in range(n)]

        def add_edge(self, fr, to, cap, cost):
            m = len(self.pos)
            self.pos.append((fr, len(self.g[fr])))
            self.g[fr].append(self._Edge(to, len(self.g[to]), cap, cost))
            self.g[to].append(self._Edge(fr, len(self.g[fr]) - 1, 0, -cost))
            return m

        class Edge:
            def __init__(self, fr, to, cap, flow, cost):
                self.fr = fr
                self.to = to
                self.cap = cap
                self.flow = flow
                self.cost = cost

        def get_edge(self, i):
            e = self.g[self.pos[i][0]][self.pos[i][1]]
            re = self.g[e.to][e.rev]
            return self.Edge(self.pos[i][0], e.to, e.cap + re.cap, re.cap, e.cost)

        def edges(self):
            res = []
            for i in range(len(self.pos)):
                e = self.g[self.pos[i][0]][self.pos[i][1]]
                re = self.g[e.to][e.rev]
                res.append(self.Edge(self.pos[i][0], e.to, e.cap + re.cap, re.cap, e.cost))
            return res

        def _dual_ref(self, s, t):
            INF = 10**18
            dist = [INF] * self.n
            pv = [-1] * self.n
            pe = [-1] * self.n
            vis = [False] * self.n
            dist[s] = 0
            pq = [(0, s)]
            while pq:
                d, v = heapq.heappop(pq)
                if vis[v]:
                    continue
                vis[v] = True
                if v == t:
                    break
                for i, e in enumerate(self.g[v]):
                    if vis[e.to] or e.cap == 0:
                        continue
                    cost = e.cost - self.dual[e.to] + self.dual[v]
                    nd = d + cost
                    if dist[e.to] > nd:
                        dist[e.to] = nd
                        pv[e.to] = v
                        pe[e.to] = i
                        heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, e.to))
            if not vis[t]:
                return False
            for v in range(self.n):
                if vis[v]:
                    self.dual[v] -= dist[t] - dist[v]
            self.pv = pv
            self.pe = pe
            return True

        def slope(self, s, t, flow_limit=10**18):
            self.dual = [0] * self.n
            flow = 0
            cost = 0
            prev_cost = -1
            result = [(flow, cost)]
            while flow < flow_limit:
                if not self._dual_ref(s, t):
                    break
                c = flow_limit - flow
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    c = min(c, self.g[self.pv[v]][self.pe[v]].cap)
                    v = self.pv[v]
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    e = self.g[self.pv[v]][self.pe[v]]
                    e.cap -= c
                    self.g[v][e.rev].cap += c
                    v = self.pv[v]
                d = -self.dual[s]
                flow += c
                cost += c * d
                if prev_cost == d:
                    result.pop()
                result.append((flow, cost))
                prev_cost = d
            return result

        def flow(self, s, t, flow_limit=10**18):
            return self.slope(s, t, flow_limit)[-1]

        class _Edge:
            def __init__(self, to, rev, cap, cost):
                self.to = to
                self.rev = rev
                self.cap = cap
                self.cost = cost

    INF = 10**9
    g = Graph(8)
    g.add_edge(0, 1, a1, 0)
    g.add_edge(0, 2, a2, 0)
    g.add_edge(0, 3, a3, 0)
    g.add_edge(4, 7, b1, 0)
    g.add_edge(5, 7, b2, 0)
    g.add_edge(6, 7, b3, 0)
    for i in range(1, 4):
        for j in range(4, 7):
            cost = 1 if (j - i) % 3 == 1 else 0
            g.add_edge(i, j, INF, cost)

    f, ans1 = g.flow(0, 7)
    ans2 = min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1)
    sys.stdout.write(f"{ans1} {ans2}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Graph {
        int n;
        ArrayList<int[]> pos; // each element is [fr, idx]
        ArrayList<ArrayList<_Edge>> g;
        long[] dual;
        int[] pv, pe;

        Graph(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            pos = new ArrayList<>();
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        int addEdge(int fr, int to, long cap, long cost) {
            int m = pos.size();
            pos.add(new int[]{fr, g.get(fr).size()});
            _Edge e1 = new _Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap, cost);
            _Edge e2 = new _Edge(fr, g.get(fr).size() - 1, 0, -cost);
            g.get(fr).add(e1);
            g.get(to).add(e2);
            return m;
        }

        Edge getEdge(int i) {
            int[] p = pos.get(i);
            _Edge e = g.get(p[0]).get(p[1]);
            _Edge re = g.get(e.to).get(e.rev);
            return new Edge(p[0], e.to, e.cap + re.cap, re.cap, e.cost);
        }

        List<Edge> edges() {
            List<Edge> res = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < pos.size(); i++) {
                int[] p = pos.get(i);
                _Edge e = g.get(p[0]).get(p[1]);
                _Edge re = g.get(e.to).get(e.rev);
                res.add(new Edge(p[0], e.to, e.cap + re.cap, re.cap, e.cost));
            }
            return res;
        }

        boolean _dualRef(int s, int t) {
            long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;
            long[] dist = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            pv = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(pv, -1);
            pe = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(pe, -1);
            boolean[] vis = new boolean[n];
            dist[s] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] cur = pq.poll();
                long d = cur[0];
                int v = (int) cur[1];
                if (vis[v]) continue;
                vis[v] = true;
                if (v == t) break;
                ArrayList<_Edge> edges = g.get(v);
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                    _Edge e = edges.get(i);
                    if (vis[e.to] || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    long cost = e.cost - dual[e.to] + dual[v];
                    long nd = d + cost;
                    if (dist[e.to] > nd) {
                        dist[e.to] = nd;
                        pv[e.to] = v;
                        pe[e.to] = i;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{nd, e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!vis[t]) return false;
            for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                if (vis[v]) {
                    dual[v] -= dist[t] - dist[v];
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        List<long[]> slope(int s, int t, long flowLimit) {
            dual = new long[n];
            long flow = 0;
            long cost = 0;
            long prevCost = -1;
            List<long[]> result = new ArrayList<>();
            result.add(new long[]{flow, cost});
            while (flow < flowLimit) {
                if (!_dualRef(s, t)) break;
                long c = flowLimit - flow;
                int v = t;
                while (v != s) {
                    _Edge e = g.get(pv[v]).get(pe[v]);
                    c = Math.min(c, e.cap);
                    v = pv[v];
                }
                v = t;
                while (v != s) {
                    _Edge e = g.get(pv[v]).get(pe[v]);
                    e.cap -= c;
                    _Edge rev = g.get(v).get(e.rev);
                    rev.cap += c;
                    v = pv[v];
                }
                long d = -dual[s];
                flow += c;
                cost += c * d;
                if (prevCost == d) {
                    result.remove(result.size() - 1);
                }
                result.add(new long[]{flow, cost});
                prevCost = d;
            }
            return result;
        }

        long[] flow(int s, int t, long flowLimit) {
            List<long[]> res = slope(s, t, flowLimit);
            return res.get(res.size() - 1);
        }

        static class Edge {
            int fr, to;
            long cap, flow, cost;
            Edge(int fr, int to, long cap, long flow, long cost) {
                this.fr = fr;
                this.to = to;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        static class _Edge {
            int to, rev;
            long cap, cost;
            _Edge(int to, int rev, long cap, long cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        solve();
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line = br.readLine();
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        int idx = 0;
        int n = Integer.parseInt(tokens[idx++]);
        long a1 = Long.parseLong(tokens[idx++]);
        long a2 = Long.parseLong(tokens[idx++]);
        long a3 = Long.parseLong(tokens[idx++]);
        long b1 = Long.parseLong(tokens[idx++]);
        long b2 = Long.parseLong(tokens[idx++]);
        long b3 = Long.parseLong(tokens[idx++]);

        long INF = 1000000000L; // 10^9
        Graph g = new Graph(8);
        g.addEdge(0, 1, a1, 0);
        g.addEdge(0, 2, a2, 0);
        g.addEdge(0, 3, a3, 0);
        g.addEdge(4, 7, b1, 0);
        g.addEdge(5, 7, b2, 0);
        g.addEdge(6, 7, b3, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
                long cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
                g.addEdge(i, j, INF, cost);
            }
        }

        long[] res = g.flow(0, 7, Long.MAX_VALUE);
        long ans1 = res[1]; // cost
        long ans2 = Math.min(a1, b2) + Math.min(a2, b3) + Math.min(a3, b1);
        System.out.println(ans1 + " " + ans2);
    }
}
